title: SLU to Host Every Voice, Every Vote: Exploring Civic Life Across Missouri
summary_en: Saint Louis University’s William L. Clay Sr. Institute of Civic Engagement and Economic Justice will host a public conversation, “Every Voice, Every Vote: Exploring Civic Life Across Missouri,” on Monday, Oct. 26. The panel discussion will explore how election laws and civic institutions shape public trust in elections.
